notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.2 — a visual release with one honesty fix underneath. The main window, the browser video picker and the download progress card now share a single light glass finish, and the download list carries status dots and an in-row progress bar. The video picker opens as a proper panel — thumbnail, title, quality list with real sizes, and just two buttons: Cancel and Download. Re-sending a video that is already downloading now behaves honestly: a different name gets its own download, the same name is recognised as already downloading. Also fixed: Speed Limiter edits lost while typing, unreadable dark-theme dropdowns, a manual update-check verdict that vanished too soon, a speed field that could show 0.3000001, an unreadable detail-bar percentage, and the downloading dot disappearing on selected rows.
